positions.name: ASML Holding N.V.
positions.catalyst: Q2 2026 beat + FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE RAISE (third raise this year). EPS/revenue topped consensus (~$7.94 EPS / ~$10.3B rev est), management lifted 2026 sales outlook citing AI-driven demand outpacing supply. Stock up ~3.6% pre-market on the print.
positions.driver: Fresh, unambiguous idiosyncratic earnings catalyst in the monopoly EUV-lithography supplier — clean direction, room to run (only +3.6% pre-market, well below the >8-10% chase threshold), and a definable stop. Macro (June PPI, 8:30am ET) resolves BEFORE the 9:30 open, so it clears ahead of entry rather than inside the hold window.
positions.risks: Semis are volatile — options priced an ~8% post-earnings swing, so a gap-fill/fade is possible. Sector-wide risk-off (rates/AI-capex sentiment) or a hot PPI could pressure high-multiple names. Hard stop at -6% ($1729.31) caps downside.
